messages:
jamie: Hey folks — candidate for Senior Infra Eng is scheduled Thurs 10:00 AM PT. Quick ask: can we confirm panelists and who will scribe? Also thinking about a small rubric tweak for this role (system design weight). Any objections to finalizing weights now?

maya_k: I can be scribe + lead the 10-min debrief after.

elena: I have a calendar conflict at 10–10:30, can we push to 11? otherwise I might be late by 10–15m.

samir_patel: I can only do 10. If we move to 11 I can't make it. prefer keep at 10.

priya: I can do either but prefer 10. Quick rubric proposal: technical 50 / product 30 / collaboration 20 — seems right for infra role.

aisha: Agree on the weights. Also please add a recording consent line to the invite (we need explicit YES).

people_ops_bot: Template: "Recording consent: Please reply YES if we can record this interview for internal debrief purposes only."

jamie: OK sounds like we keep 10 so panel = @samir_patel, @elena, @priya; @maya_k will scribe. @maya_k can you add the consent line to the invite and set a 10-min debrief immediately after? Debrief expectations: bring 3 bullets — strengths, risks, hire recommendation (hire / hire-lean / no-hire).

maya_k: Confirmed — will update calendar, add consent, and take scribe notes in the candidate doc.

priya: :thumbsup: I'll draft two short example evals in the candidate doc. One quick Q: scoring scale — are we using 1–5 or 1–4 this cycle?

jamie: Use 1–5 for this loop to match the updated hiring rubric. Paste of the quick scoring fields for reference:

```
System design (50%): score 1-5
Product-thinking (30%): score 1-5
Collaboration & communication (20%): score 1-5
Overall rec: hire / lean-hire / no-hire
Notes: 3 bullets (strengths, risks, action items)
```

aisha: I'll handle candidate follow-up questions after debrief and make sure we capture consent reply.

jamie: Thanks all — I'll send the updated invite in ~5m. Please add any eval notes to the candidate doc within 24h after the interview.
